title: Other chart equations vanish in the single-chart zero-base quotient
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R and R2=R/(pi^2). Let d be polynomial data as in [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]: Q=R[x_i,z_l], u_l=f_l-pi*z_l and p_kl=a_k*z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_klj*z_j-pi*g_kl. Put A=R2[x_i]/(reduced(f_l)), and ak the image of reduced(a_k) in A. Fix k in Fin(r). Define J_k=(u_l for all l, p_kl for all l) in Q and T_k=ULift(Q/J_k). For a commutative R-algebra B killing pi, put t=1 tensor the class of a_k in B tensor_R T_k. Localizations mean [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Assume compatible R- and R2-algebra structures on Cbar and that d is prepared, including its cleared relations and the specified conormal bases. For every k prime in Fin(r) and l in Fin(m), the class of p_kprime,l maps to zero in (B tensor_R T_k)[1/t]. No R2-algebra structure on B, no prime and no flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: In B tensor_R T_k the relations u_l=0 and pi=0 give f_l=0 for every l; the relations p_kl=0 hold by definition. These equalities persist after localization at t.

proof.text: Fix another chart k prime and l. Multiply its reduced cleared f-relation by a_k and replace each a_k*f_jprime by the k-th reduced cleared relation. Compare with a_kprime times the k-th relation for f_l in the reduced conormal module. The difference is sum_{j in E_k}b_j*f_j with b_j=a_kprime*h_klj-sum_{jprime in E_kprime}h_kprime,l,jprime*h_k,jprime,j. The prepared conormal basis on E_k forces each coefficient b_j to be zero in A[1/ak].

proof.text: The localization equality criterion clears a power of ak, putting that power times reduced(b_j) in the ideal generated by reduced(f_l). Lift the finite ideal-membership expression through coefficient reduction R[x] to R2[x]; its remaining error has coefficients divisible by pi squared. In B tensor_R T_k, all f_l and pi squared vanish. Since the image of a_k is a unit after localization, every b_j vanishes there.

proof.text: Expand a_k*p_kprime,l-a_kprime*p_kl+sum_{jprime in E_kprime}h_kprime,l,jprime*p_k,jprime. Modulo pi it equals sum_{j in E_k}b_j*z_j. Every term other than a_k*p_kprime,l is zero in the localized single-chart quotient. Multiply by the inverse of a_k to conclude p_kprime,l=0. This proves the requested relation on each index; no flatness or prime hypothesis was used.

lean.statement:
theorem zero_base_chart_relations (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (B : Type b) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (hπ : algebraMap R B π = 0) (k : Fin d.r)
    (k' : Fin d.r) (l : Fin d.m) :
    let J : Ideal d.polynomial := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d.m ⊕ Fin d.m ↦
      match i with
      | .inl j => d.equation (.inl j)
      | .inr l => d.equation (.inr (k, l))))
    let Dk := ULift.{c} (d.polynomial ⧸ J)
    let t := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := B)
      (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (d.includeX (d.a k))))
    algebraMap (B ⊗[R] Dk) (Localization.Away t)
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := B)
        (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (d.equation (.inr (k', l)))))) = 0
